Fully Funded Scholarships for Computer Science in Germany Skip to content Hello Computer Science students, are you looking for CS scholarships in Germany? Do you want to get fully funded scholarships to get your future bright in Computer science, then you are at right place ,we have listed some good and 100% working scholarships. Below we have listed those links for you, just check out those scholarships by simply clicking on links. Here are the top 10 scholarships for Master’s degrees in Computer Science in Germany, along with their application links: Here are the top 10 scholarships for Master’s degrees in Computer Science in Germany, along with their application links: Table of Contents Toggle 1. DAAD Scholarships for Development-Related Postgraduate Courses The DAAD (German Academic Exchange Service) offers scholarships for international students to pursue master’s degrees in various fields, including Computer Science. Link: DAAD EPOS Scholarship 2.HeinrichBöll Foundation Scholarships:- Details: The Heinrich Böll Foundation awards scholarships to international students pursuing a master’s degree in Germany, including in Computer Science. Link:[ Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships ] 3. Friedrich Ebert Foundation Scholarships:- Details: This foundation supports international students who are socially engaged and are pursuing master’s studies in Germany. Link: [ Friedrich Ebert Foundation Scholarships ] 4. Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung Scholarships:- Details: The Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung provides scholarships to international students who have above-average academic achievements and are pursuing master’s programs in Germany. Link: [ Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung Scholarships ] 5. Deutschlandstipendium:- Details: The Deutschlandstipendium supports talented students at all participating universities in Germany, irrespective of their nationality. Link: [ Deutschlandstipendium ] 6. Humboldt Research Fellowship for International Students:- Details: Although primarily for doctoral and post-doctoral researchers, highly qualified graduates can apply for research fellowships. Link: [ Humboldt Research Fellowship ] 7.Bayer Foundation Scholarships:- Details: These scholarships support students in fields such as computer science, biology, and chemistry who wish to study or undertake a research project in Germany. Link: [ Bayer Foundation Fellowships ] 8. Erasmus+ Programme:- Details: Erasmus+ provides opportunities for students to study abroad in Europe, including Germany, for part of their master’s degree. Link: [ Erasmus+ Programme ] 9. Rosa Luxemburg Foundation Scholarships:- Details: The Rosa Luxemburg Foundation offers scholarships to international students who demonstrate exceptional academic performance and are committed to social justice. Link:[ Rosa Luxemburg Foundation Scholarships ] 10. Friedrich Naumann Foundation Scholarships Details: This foundation offers scholarships for international students pursuing a master’s degree in Germany, especially those interested in political science, economics, and computer science. Link:[ Friedrich Naumann Foundation Scholarships ] These scholaships have varying eligibility criteria and deadlines, so it’s advisable to check their respective websites for detailed information and application procedures. Conclusion: So these are the list of scholarships for computer science students who want to get enrolled in German universities.
